title: Staircased Dripleaf
description: Generates Dripleaf as natural staircase parkour formations
body:
> **NOTE:** _This mod is packaged as part of [Great Big World](https://modrinth.com/mod/great-big-world) and was made a standalone mod so that players can enjoy it separately. Do not download both with the intent of using them together._

# Staircased Dripleaf
A simple mod that generates Big Dripleaf as natural staircase parkour formations.

This makes Dripleaf a natural parkour course, making it more interactive & fun.

![Lightning Flash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/CIlKP7Pq/images/b72d9f5e1bf09cd643c9e68d1e796a47d6a729b6.png)

> _This mod is free to use in modpacks with credit._
